title: SIDE REVEAL MLDGS & SEALING
summary: Windshield side reveal moldings (the exterior trim running up each windshield pillar / A-pillar) and the sealing where the windshield upper reveal molding meets the roof center support (T-top center bar) reveal molding. A retainer is riveted to the pillar (4 holes) and screwed at its top; the molding snaps over it, with a cemented sealing strip between and sealing-compound beads at the windshield header joints.
